itens.titulo: How Has Alphabet Stock's Story Changed?
itens.descricao: How Has Alphabet Stock's Story Changed? Yahoo Finance
trechos: In April 2024, managing its own cost base was a major strategic focus.
By July 2026, spending on AI infrastructure had taken center stage.
Management plans 2026 capital spending of $195 billion to $205 billion.
The plan exceeds the $185.7 billion of cash its operations made over the past year.
In the Q1 FY2024 call, it said it was focused on long-term efforts to re-engineer its cost base.
Over the past year, Alphabet's revenue was $445.9 billion.
Its operating income, the profit from the business itself, was $147.6 billion.
The difference is about $298 billion of operating costs.
